summary.text: Odus Evbagharu is the Democratic candidate for Texas House of Representatives District 135 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican Liz Ramos in a race with no incumbent.
A small business owner, he is a former Harris County Democratic Party chair, according to his Ballotpedia survey responses.

paragraphs.text: Odus Evbagharu graduated from Langham Creek High School and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Houston.
His career experience includes working as a business owner.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a son of immigrants who grew up in Cy-Fair schools, said he served as Harris County Democratic Party Chair, and said he founded Onward Strategy Group to support local candidates and causes.
He won the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary for District 135 with no opposition.
He listed strong public schools, economic opportunity and small business growth, and safe, healthy communities as his key campaign messages.
